_ConnectionStrings_note: Passwords are injected at runtime (ConnectionStrings__Producer / ConnectionStrings__Admin via env var / user-secrets); never committed. Producer = pol_app (RLS-scoped, tenant-facing, the default path). Admin = pol_admin (RLS-bypass) used ONLY by the cross-tenant provisioning endpoints (POST/GET /admin/tenants).
_Google_note: Tenant SPA uses the id-token-as-bearer path: map its Google OAuth client id under Audiences (Google__Audiences__tenant), validated as a token audience -> 'tenant' role claim. The admin SPA uses the server-side OIDC BFF (Google:Oidc below), NOT an audience.

Google._Oidc_note: Confidential OIDC client for the admin BFF login (REQ-1/2/8). ClientId/ClientSecret are the admin 'Web application' Google client; the secret is injected at runtime (Google__Oidc__ClientSecret), never committed. Blank here -> fail-fast at boot outside Development.

_AdminSession_note: Server-side admin session lifetime + cookie posture (REQ-3/5/7). SameSite=Lax assumes admin SPA + API are same-site; set None for a cross-site deploy. ReturnUrlAllowlist is the open-redirect allowlist for post-login returnTo (same-origin paths only).
_AdminAllowlist_note: Bootstrap allowlist for the first Super admin(s): Google subjects allowed to self-provision as Super on first login (admin-actor-rename REQ-5). Empty here; set per env via AdminAllowlist__Subjects__0. Bootstrap-only gate — removing a subject does NOT revoke an existing admin (suspend via POST /admin/admins/{id}/suspend). Empty outside Development logs a fail-closed boot warning.
_Cors_note: Browser SPA frontend origins. AllowedOrigins = tenant console (Bearer, no credentials); AdminOrigins = admin console (cookie XHR, credentialed). Empty here (no cross-origin allowed); set per env via Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 and Cors__AdminOrigins__0.
